In the role of Senior Transportation Engineer, we'll count on you to
Provide transportation engineering services for transit, highway, state agencies, cities and counties
Take responsibility for corridor studies, forecast modeling, traffic analysis, transportation planning, and impact fee development
Collect project-related data as needed, which may include research, interviews with government agencies and clients, map reviews, land use surveys, and socioeconomic analysis
Prepare required documents such as categorical exclusions, environmental assessments, environmental impact studies and other technical reports
Assist in preparation for and participate in public information meetings and hearings
